WELCOME TO MAIN STREET FEEDS!
Custom mixed feeds to meet your needs.
“ We bust ours to save yours!
NEW PRODUCT!!
Main Street Feeds is now carrying dried distillers grain cubes and pellets. Both products are 28% protein. The cubes are a compact and durable product that work great for feeding on pasture or in a bunk. They are a unique combination of concentrated energy, 95% digestible protein and low residual starch which accelerates growth, reduces digestive issues, improves forage utilization, and boosts reproductive performance.
The creep pellets are perfect for weaning and growing calves. They work well in a free choice feeder and in feedlot bunks. These pellets are a high energy, high protein product, and are naturally palatable which makes the calves want to eat them. They are great for reducing stress, promoting bone and muscle development, and improving overall herd health.
Available at both locations….
Feel free to come in and have a discussion about these products.
MAIN STREET FEEDS CARRIES SEVERAL FEED RATIONS FOR YOU TO CHOOSE FROM. IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO HAVE A SPECIAL FEED MIX MADE , GIVE EITHER LOCATION A CALL, AND WE WILL BE HAPPY TO GET YOU A FEED MIX MADE UP THAT SUITS YOUR SPECIFIC NEEDS.
WE SELL OUR CREEP FEEDS IN BULK, AS WELL AS 50# BAGS. WE KEEP MOST OF OUR BAGGED CREEP FEEDS ON HAND, BUT GIVE US A CALL, AND WE WILL BE SURE TO GET YOU WHAT YOU NEED.
IN ADDITION TO BULK AND BAGGED FEED, MAIN STREET FEEDS CARRIES FARM AND RANCH EQUIPMENT
SUCH AS WATERERS, FEEDERS, TUBS, GATES, PANELS, AND FENCING SUPPLIES.
MAIN STREET FEEDS PROUDLY OFFERS PURINA MINERAL.
Purina all season mineral is also available with mag, availa 4, and fly control, depending on the season.
TUBS
Main Street Feeds has several tub options available.
We have all natural tubs, as well as ones with urea, and tubs with availa. We also have all-purpose tubs.
We have Profit Builder 12 and 14, as well as the Forage Booster 16. Tubs are also available with mag.
Come in and get the tub that fits your operation. If one location doesn’t have the tub you want, we will gladly bring it from the other location.
Be sure when feeding tubs you always have fresh water, forage, and salt available at all times.
TUB SPECIAL!!!!! Buy 8 tubs. Pick up all at one time, Get $4 off per tub.
Main Street Feeds has Apache Creep Feeders, as well as feed bins available to purchase. Our creep feeds are made daily, and can be delivered easily to your farm. Call and set up an account today! We also offer QLF, and will come and fill your tanks.
Did You Know??
We offer:
** Grain hauling to Deerfield and Kansas City, MO **
** Semi grain hauling to your farm!! **
Call us next time you need a load of soybeans taken to K.C. or maybe a load of SHP picked up in Deerfield, MO!!
(800)-299-6680 ask for Tim

Our stores provide Feed, Forage Testing, Ration Balancing, Animal Health Products, Fencing Supplies, Livestock Equipment, Farm Supplies and Much More. We, at Main Street Feeds, strive to keep our customers satisfied with quality products and services. Remember, “We bust ours… to save yours.”
